notes: uiMapID: 1420 is the retail/modern uiMapID for Tirisfal Glades (warcraft.wiki.gg UiMapID table; Wowhead zone id is 85). NOT confirmed from a WoW Forever page: Wowhead Forever pages expose no uiMapID. Verify in game with C_Map.GetBestMapForUnit('player') in Tirisfal Glades.

Wowhead Forever quest/zone/npc pages load only partially via the fetch tool (no Level, Start/End, Quick Facts, coordinates). Only quest names, gains, series and some end NPCs were readable (verified on 363, 98389, 95328). Nearly all data therefore comes from forever-xp.com (a Forever-specific site, secondary source). forever-xp.com returned HTTP 403 on 2026-11-04, so the 2026-11-04 gap fixes were made from wowforever.wclbox.com instead. The other secondary sites (wowforeverguides.com, 60.tools) were not consulted.

forever=true means the quest appears in forever-xp.com Forever data. Nothing was found Classic-Era only. Classic-ID quests in Forever may still have changed levels/XP versus Classic Era (e.g. Deathknell and Brill quests have shifted levels), so use these values, not Classic ones.
xpEstimated=true: forever-xp shows the XP with '~' (estimate, no player logs yet). Treat as unconfirmed.

Forever-new quests included in this file: 98389, 96656, 96607, 97951, 96658, 99134, 99141, 99144, 86784, 99152, 95314, 99153, 97558, 99142, 96895, 96897, 96898, 96899, 96896, 98545, 99156, 95328 (22). Quest 5847 'Welcome!' has a Classic-range ID and was not marked NEW, but start NPC/source is unknown; treat as unverified.

Ten more Forever-new optional profession quests 'Camping 101' exist, all level 6, minLevel 4 (presumably), ~135 XP, started by Eleanor Shackleton (57.3, 55.5) after The Great Outdoors chain: 97952 Blacksmithing, 97953 Enchanting, 97954 Engineering, 97955 First Aid, 97956 Fishing, 97957 Herbalism, 97958 Leatherworking, 97959 Mining, 97960 Skinning, 97961 Tailoring. Only Alchemy (97951) and Cooking (96658) were fetched for end NPC; the rest were not fetched individually. Note the page for 96658 lists 95998 and 96101/96604/96605/96606 as related 'The Great Outdoors' quests (other zones' variants, not in this file).

NPC ids (npcId) are mostly missing: forever-xp does not list them and Wowhead Forever NPC pages did not load. Only 1569 (Shadow Priest Sarvis) and 4607 (Father Lankester) were seen on Wowhead Forever pages. Do not guess others.

Coordinates are percentages on the Tirisfal Glades map, as published by forever-xp. Quests whose 'start' is {} have no start NPC listed (item-started: 361 from Thurman Agamand's letter, 5847 Deathknell Gift Voucher, 95328 Whispering Horror Residue item drop). Where 'end' is omitted the source does not list a turn-in NPC (590, 99134, 372, 99152, 99153, 96896, 431, 410); most probably turn in to the start NPC but this is not stated.
Where 'end' equals 'start' it was inferred from the objective text ('return to X') on forever-xp, or (2026-11-04 fixes) read directly from wclbox.

Quests 8 and 590 'A Rogue's Deal' are both listed with no class restriction on forever-xp, and 590 start is listed at Calvin Montague; the chain text is odd (8: deliver letter to Innkeeper Renee, 590: defeat Calvin). Verify the real start/turn-in and any class restriction (quest 8 is a Rogue-flavored name). forever-xp marks 8 'In route' and 590 'Skip'.

Deathknell start area: Rude Awakening (363) starts at Undertaker Mordo; 364, 3901 and the class scroll quests (3095-3099, 90902, 98601 listed as follow-ups of 363/364 by forever-xp) are class-specific. Class quests NOT collected: 3095 Simple Scroll (Rogue?), 3096 Encrypted Scroll, 3097 Hallowed Scroll, 3098 Glyphic Scroll, 3099 Tainted Scroll, 90902 Rediscovering the Light, 98601 A Difficult Path, and class trainer quests listed under other pages. forever-xp's Deathknell zone page lists only 13 quests, none of them class quests; the class quests need a separate pass (class-to-quest mapping not verified).
forever-xp Tirisfal page also lists non-route quests not included: 5901 and 5902 A Plague Upon Thee (level 55, Mickey Levine at 83.3, 72.3, Horde).

Level 12+ and chain gaps: The 'followUps'/'prereqs' lists are taken from forever-xp chain text and are sometimes ambiguous (e.g. 99152/99153 prereq 96896; 96899 prereqs are listed as 96895, 96897, 96898; 372 prereqs 427/370/371 are chain order, not hard prerequisites). Verify in game before building route dependencies.

Flight paths: none recorded. Deathknell has no flight master; Tirisfal has no flight master at all (nearest Horde one is in Undercity, then The Sepulcher in Silverpine) per games.gg. Innkeeper Renee location (61.7, 52) derived from the end point of quest 8 on forever-xp.

Zeppelin tower (Tirisfal side): sits on the road between Brill and the Undercity gates (warcraft.wiki.gg, games.gg, wowhandbook.com). Exact coordinates NOT found in any source; do not invent them. See the-barrens.json for the Durotar side (50.8, 13.4).
